name: phase_v2_signal_retention
purpose: Build and evaluate a separately-versioned experimental Phase v2 that tests whether selective updates + bounded multi-timescale state preserve a distant focus cue that frozen Phase v1 dilutes via dense no-decay accumulation.

prior_negative_result_recorded.distance_diagnostic: rare focus signal declines ~1/N; Phase topic decoding near chance; no-decay cumulative state dilutes

hypothesis: Selective writes into a persistent (gamma~1) bank preserve a rare distant focus cue across long distractor sequences that dense accumulation dilutes.

variants.V1: frozen Phase v1 (dense, no decay, no gate) — negative baseline

training_modes.gate_sup: + supervised write gate (write header, skip distractors) — research scaffold, not an inference oracle

acceptance_gate: See report; V2-S/gate_sup is the candidate. Downstream integration (oracle-slot retention / bounded quadratic hybrid) gated on passing.
